name: Someone to Hold Me
source:
A very short, simple visual novel made in a week, starring an asexual girl and her internal and social tribulations. 

"I want someone to hold me, but not the way he wants to." 

[From [url=https://meiri.itch.io/holdme]itch.io[/url]]
